narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Big Bronze Bomb, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hey, there's the bomb I ordered! Well, one of them anyway. I needed a variety pack! You know, enough so I can test each one for effectiveness AND have a few leftover for my own needs! Well, whatever. Here's a cut of your cut, I'll give you the rest when you bring ME my full order!
